title: Blood pressure follow-up
transcript: Good morning, Mr. Venkatesh. Please sit down. How have you been since the last visit? Good morning, doctor. I have been fine mostly, but I get a mild headache in the mornings, maybe three days in a week. I see. Are you checking your blood pressure at home, as I had asked? Yes doctor. My son bought a machine. Every morning before tea I check it. The reading is around 150 over 94 on most days. That is still higher than where we want it. Today in the clinic it is 148 over 92. Your pulse is 78 and regular. I was afraid it would be high. I had pickles and papad at my cousin's wedding last week. Salt is a big part of this, so please keep that down. Tell me, are you taking Telma 40 milligrams every day without missing? Yes, one tablet every morning after breakfast. Maybe I missed it twice this month when we travelled. Okay. Any swelling in the feet, cough, or dizziness when you stand up? No swelling. No cough. Sometimes a little dizzy if I get up fast from the sofa. That is good to know. Since the pressure is still high on one medicine, I am going to add a second one. I am starting Amlodipine 5 milligrams, one tablet at night. At night, after dinner? Yes, after dinner is fine. It can cause a little ankle swelling in some people, so tell me if you notice that. Okay doctor. And the Telma continues as before? Continue Telma 40 milligrams in the morning. Do not stop it on your own even if the readings look good. Understood. Should I continue the aspirin also? The one my cardiologist gave. You mean Ecosprin 75 milligrams? Yes, continue that once a day after lunch. It protects your heart, and the stomach upset you had earlier has settled, so we do not need to change it. And the cholesterol tablet, Atorvastatin? Continue Atorvastatin 10 milligrams at bedtime. I want to check your numbers, so I am ordering a fasting lipid profile. Please do it after ten to twelve hours of fasting. Can I take my medicines on the morning of the test? Yes, take the Telma with a sip of water. Only skip your breakfast and tea until the blood is drawn. Okay. What should my home readings be? Aim for below 130 over 80. Write down the morning and evening readings for one week and bring the diary with you. I will ask my wife to write it in the notebook. She is more regular than I am. That is a good idea. Also walk for thirty minutes daily, and reduce papad, pickle and packet snacks. I walk in the park near the lake. I will try to go every day, not only on Sundays. Good. If you ever get chest pain, severe headache, or sudden weakness on one side, do not wait for the appointment. Go to the emergency room immediately. Yes doctor, I understand. Let me also check your kidney function in the same sample, since two blood pressure medicines can affect it. I will add a serum creatinine to the form. Fine. When should I come back? Come back in four weeks with the lipid report and the diary. If the pressure is controlled, we will not add anything more. Thank you doctor. Shall I take the new tablet from today? Yes, from tonight. Amlodipine 5 milligrams after dinner, Telma 40 milligrams in the morning, Ecosprin 75 milligrams after lunch, and Atorvastatin 10 milligrams at bedtime. Is that clear? Yes, four tablets at four different times. I will keep the pill box ready. Perfect. The pharmacy downstairs has everything. Take care, Mr. Venkatesh, and see you in four weeks. Thank you, doctor. Goodbye.
